Where the money goes

      Assumptions
      • Figures show the payroll tax your employer withholds under the official 2026 algorithm (BMF Programmablaufplan). Your final tax after a tax return can differ, for example because of work expenses or Soli on the 13th salary.
      • The 13th salary equals one monthly gross salary and is paid in November. A summer bonus is paid in the month you choose (April to October), before the 13th salary.
      • Children are under 25, and those 18 or older are in education or training. In tax classes 1 and 2 each child counts as half a child allowance, because parents usually share it; in classes 3 and 4 as a full one. This only affects Soli and church tax. Parents whose children are all 25 or older pay no care insurance surcharge for the childless.
      • Private health insurance: the whole premium is treated as basic cover for tax purposes. The employer pays half, up to the 2026 maximum for health and care insurance together (the law caps the two separately). In tax class 6 the premium is paid through the main job.
      • Social contributions use the 2026 rates and caps. Mini- and midijobs, self-employment and the class 4 factor method are not covered.

      How the calculation works

      Based on the official 2026 payroll tax algorithm of the German Ministry of Finance (BMF). Everything is calculated in your browser; nothing you enter leaves this page. Not tax advice; all figures without guarantee.
